name: StartFast

sources.title: Homepage — live curated directory of AI tools & tech products for founders (13+ categories, collections, newsletter)
Add your product — simple form: name, email, product name, website URL, note; no sign-in required

requirements: AI tools, apps, and tech products aimed at founders, makers, and startups
Directory is 'curated for quality' — expect editorial review before listing
No account needed — the form only asks for contact name/email plus product name, URL, and a note
preparation: A short note pitching the product (the 'Note' field is the only free-text space — make it count)
Category in mind (Development Tools, AI Products, Productivity, Marketing, AI Agents, etc.)
workflow: Fill Your Name, Your Email, product Name, Website URL, and Note
Optionally tick the newsletter checkbox and click Submit
Await editorial review; listings appear in /categories and tool pages
watchFor: No stated review turnaround or acceptance criteria beyond 'curated for quality'
Very light form — no fields for logo, pricing, or description beyond the note; editors likely enrich listings themselves
Site carries affiliate links and paid /advertise placements — the free listing competes with sponsored spots
Part of a small indie network (footer links GitHub awesome-micro-saas; sibling sites power other directories)
countsAsLive: The product appears on startfa.st under a category page and as a tool entry with its tagline
unknowns: Whether the 'Note' is published verbatim or used only for review
Whether paid placement affects organic listing order
